records.title: Birma (Burma): Amerikanske soldater i kamp i jungelen / 19. jun. 1944 · Filmavisen 1944
records.description:
Story number in issue: 9
Amerikansk filmklipp fra jungelen i Birma (Burma) i Asia. Viser soldatene i kamp, ikke bare mot innbitte japanske styrker, men også mot en fiendtlig og ukjent natur. Oversiktsbilder amerikansk feltflyplass med fly. Soldater med full oppakning går ombord i flyene. Kondensstriper etter fly på himmelen. Oversikt fallskjermer daler mot bakken, sett fra fly. Amerikanske soldater i kamp i jungelen. Sårede soldater bæres på bårer på jungelsti til forbindingsplass. Såret og blindet soldat leies gjennom sump. Støvler tråkker i sump. (Kommentator: Egil Nakling (?), NRK). Filmavisen var en ukentlig nyhetsbulletin som gikk som forfilm på kino i årene 1941 - 1963. Bulletinene var produsert av Norsk Film A/S. NRK mottok filmene i 1976 og har siden sendt dem i reprise med jevne mellomrom. Samlingen er dessverre ikke komplett. 
Sendedato på det enkelte program er oppgitt premieredato på kino. Filmavisen blir også referert til som Norsk ukerevy, Norsk filmrevy og Ukerevyen. Blant kommentatorstemmene hører vi Egil Nakling (krigsårene), Halfdan Hegtun, Rolf Kirkvaag, Andor Birkeland og Knut Jørgen Erichsen.

Det er viktig å understreke at Filmavisen i krigsårene var en del av okkupasjonsmaktens propaganda.

content_rights: Internet Archive item metadata displays Public Domain Mark 1.0; the scan is credited to Google. Retain item attribution.

curator_note.zh-CN: 互联网档案馆将这本缅甸指南标为 1943 年，内容包括习俗、健康与词汇。记录列有 PDF 与预览图。
curator_note.en: Internet Archive dates this Burma guide to 1943 and lists chapters on customs, health and vocabulary, along with a PDF and preview.

records.title: A pocket guide to India
records.access_note: Digitized-book resource list and indexed metadata accessible; direct item fetch returned HTTP 403 during this check.
content_rights: LoC’s digitized-book record states the books in this collection are public domain and free to use and reuse; credit Library of Congress.

curator_note.zh-CN: 美国国会图书馆将其著录为 1944 年版本；数字化书名页注明 1944 年 4 月修订。条目访问可能受到限制。
curator_note.en: The Library of Congress describes a 1944 edition; the digitized title page states revised April 1944. Direct item access may be restricted.

records.title: Mileage chart for the China-Burma-India theater of war
records.access_note: Official indexed resource metadata and image-viewer link available; no map image reused here.
content_rights: Veterans History Project contributors may retain copyright; check item and VHP publication/exhibition guidance before reproducing.

curator_note.zh-CN: Charles E. Kavenagh 个人文献中的中缅印战区里程图。馆藏页面提供查看器链接；此处未复制地图图像。
curator_note.en: A China-Burma-India theater mileage chart in the Charles E. Kavenagh Collection. The resource offers a viewer link; no map image is reproduced here.

records.title: Frank H. Gray Collection
records.access_note: Official search-indexed metadata verified; direct item request returned HTTP 403 in this environment.
content_rights: VHP contributors retain any copyright they hold; educational availability is not a blanket reuse licence.

curator_note.zh-CN: 馆藏服役说明将 Frank H. Gray 记为从印度飞往中国、执行驼峰航线任务的 C-47 飞行员。
curator_note.en: The collection’s service note identifies Frank H. Gray as a C-47 pilot who flew the Hump from India to China.

records.title: blood chit
records.access_note: Official indexed collection metadata verified; direct page fetch returned HTTP 520 during this check.
content_rights: The Smithsonian record explicitly says Usage Conditions Apply. No image is embedded in this demo entry.

curator_note.zh-CN: 美国国家历史博物馆著录的一件棉质求救布告，与 Robley E. Winfrey 上校有关。馆方注明使用条件适用。
curator_note.en: A cotton blood chit catalogued by the National Museum of American History and associated with Col. Robley E. Winfrey. The museum states that usage conditions apply.

records.title: patch (Fourteenth Air Force)
records.access_note: Official indexed collection page supplies the description; direct canonical page was not rendered by the retrieval tool.
content_rights: Smithsonian image use is marked Usage Conditions Apply. The record link is retained without image reuse.

curator_note.zh-CN: 博物馆描述的一枚蓝色圆形第十四航空队臂章。该部队成立于 1943 年，应与最初的美国志愿航空队区分。
curator_note.en: A blue circular Fourteenth Air Force patch described by the museum. This unit dates to 1943 and is distinct from the original American Volunteer Group.

records.title: Hiding in Plane Sight
records.access_note: Official search-indexed article and photo identifier verified; direct fetch returned HTTP 403.
content_rights: Article and image reuse rights are not established in the retrieved excerpt; link only.

curator_note.zh-CN: 美国国家航空航天博物馆文章介绍飞虎队木制 P-40 诱饵，并注明档案照片编号 SI 90-13683。此处仅提供文章线索。
curator_note.en: A National Air and Space Museum article describes wooden P-40 decoys used by the Flying Tigers and cites archival photograph SI 90-13683. This entry provides a link to the article.

curator_note.en: The CIA Museum describes this silk rescue notice as an OSS artifact used in the China-Burma-India theater. No item-specific media licence was established.

curator_note.en: An Imperial War Museums record for a wartime film about the Ledo/Stilwell Road. This copy is marked not digitized, with media currently unavailable.

curator_note.zh-CN: 1945 年 7 月的新闻影片目录涉及喜马拉雅上空的 Dakota 飞机、昆明补给与返回印度的难民儿童。馆方目录列有两卷高清媒体。
curator_note.en: The July 1945 newsreel description includes a Dakota over the Himalayas, supplies at Kunming and refugee children returning to India. The catalogue lists two HD reels.

description.zh-CN: 从 P-40 战斗机照片、博物馆文章与航空队臂章认识飞虎队及相关航空部队。第十四航空队与最初的美国志愿航空队需要区分。
description.en: Explore P-40 photographs, museum articles and an air-force patch on the Flying Tigers and related air units. The Fourteenth Air Force is distinct from the original American Volunteer Group.

description.zh-CN: 通过飞行员个人文献与新闻影片，了解印度至中国的喜马拉雅空运。馆藏链接保留各自的媒体访问限制。
description.en: Follow the India-to-China Himalayan airlift through a pilot’s personal collection and a newsreel. Each record retains its own media-access limitations.

description.zh-CN: 沿公路的建设、村落与卫生调查照片，结合广播目录，观察这条交通线的不同记录。
description.en: Explore road construction, villages and health-survey photographs alongside a French broadcast record.

description.zh-CN: 工程、运输车队、地方侦察员及公路影片的机构记录。历史照片的原始地点说明仍需结合地图核实。
description.en: Institutional records of road building, supply convoys, local scouts and a road film. Original geographic captions still require map-based checking.

description.zh-CN: 照片、战地新闻影片、麦瑞尔突击队个人文献及钦迪特研究线索，展现缅甸战场与部队经历。
description.en: Photographs, wartime newsreels, a Merrill’s Marauders personal collection and Chindit research leads explore the Burma campaign and military service.

description.zh-CN: 军人个人文献呈现中国、缅甸和印度的服役经历，包括飞行、地勤与地面部队。部分条目只有目录信息。
description.en: Personal military collections offer perspectives on service in China, Burma and India, including flying, ground support and infantry. Some entries provide catalogue information only.

description.zh-CN: 中国、缅甸及印度袖珍指南、战区报刊与战时中国出版物。可在线阅读的扫描件与仅有查找指南的资料均有标注。
description.en: Pocket guides to China, Burma and India, theater newspapers and a wartime China publication. Records distinguish available scans from finding aids.

description.zh-CN: 求救布告与航空队臂章的博物馆目录。相关器物来自不同机构，其使用权与图像可用性需逐项查看。
description.en: Museum records of blood chits and an air-force patch. These objects come from different institutions; check each record for rights and image availability.

description.zh-CN: 战区里程图、兵员登记、通信与部队文件。目录层级包括系列和文件单元，并不代表每条记录已有数字化全文。
description.en: A theater mileage chart, replacement registers, communications and unit files. Series and file-unit descriptions do not imply that every record has digitized full text.

description.zh-CN: 公路沿线村落、疟疾调查、医院与民众支援的照片，记录战时卫生与日常生活。
description.en: Photographs of villages, malaria surveys, hospitals and civilian war work document wartime health and daily life.
